@tabs.library.note: ライブラリ is both apps' word and the one the coach card names the tab by (coach.tab_more); the CJK glyphs are 16 px each, so it is 80 px in the 52 px label, and no word of 3 characters names the Library (楽曲, 音楽 and 曲一覧 name the music, not the tab). A layout fix: let the active tab's label spill past its tab's edges, centred, 80 px wide (its neighbours show no label), or an icon-only tab.

@library.segment_artists.note: アーティスト is both apps' word, and Japanese has no shorter one for an artist (歌手 is a singer, アーチスト a dated spelling): 6 CJK glyphs are 102 px in Bold's 94 px segment, and 96 px in Body, still 2 px over. A layout fix: widen the three segments to 106 px (318 of the 320) and give the label w - 4, 102 px.

@library.play_all.note: N曲再生, the compact button form (as 全曲再生), 112 px in Bold's 123: with the particle (19410 曲を再生) it was 129 px, over by 6 where English is over by 3.

@library.crumb.note: ライブラリ (both apps' word; no shorter word names the Library) is 85 px in Bold's 80 px pill. A layout fix: let the pill's label take 86 px (the title has the rest), or draw a CJK pill label in Body, where it is exactly 80 px.
